title: Strict reduction tensor comparison on simultaneous representatives
statement: Fix ℓ, E and W and any core coefficient reduction record R. There exists a reduction tensor comparison μ:R.integralClosed.tensor⋙R.reduction≅(R.reduction.prod R.reduction)⋙R.systemClosed.tensor such that replacing only reductionTensor by μ satisfies CoefficientReductionTensorNormalization. In particular a single strict chain map supplies all finite ordinary tensor components and the system-derived comparison square. No finite scalar or evaluation tensor comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; representative tensor comparison and localization

proof.text: Identify the reduction functor with the sequence-projection derived pullback through uniqueness of its specified adjunction; its projection formulas preserve the finite comparisons.

Apply the canonical tensor pullback comparison on simultaneous flat-term K-flat complexes. Its strict chain map and three strict presentations have the prescribed finite components by the unique scalar and evaluation generator formulas. Descent through the supplied tensor models gives the system-derived square.

theorem coefficientStrictReductionTensorNormalization
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W) :
    ∃ μ : R.integralClosed.tensor ⋙ R.reduction ≅
      R.reduction.prod R.reduction ⋙ R.systemClosed.tensor,
      CoefficientReductionTensorNormalization l E W { R with reductionTensor := μ }
